corrections.text: The article states 100 Thieves' FATAL FURY-discipline rival winnings came 'from the discipline's $1 million prize pool.' The cited Esports World Cup recap confirms the $250,000 prize for winner DarkAngel but does not state a total prize pool figure for FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves anywhere in the source. The $1 million total-pool figure is unsourced and has been removed from consideration as a verified fact.

The article states the VALORANT grand final was held 'on Monday, July 13,' citing GosuGamers, which does state this verbatim. However, the Esports World Cup's own official Week 1 Champions Recap describes the same match as 'Sunday's Grand Final,' and a separate EWC article announcing the win was published dated July 12, 2026 in the past tense. This is an unresolved conflict between the tournament organizer's own reporting and a third-party outlet's account; readers should treat the exact date of the match as uncertain pending clarification from the Esports World Cup.
